changes.title: Treehouse look
items: Four optional Treehouse look switches let you try a fading crown, clearer approaches and open room platforms.

changes.title: Combat spacing
items: Animals move together between attacks, with different strides, close passes and formations for each kind.
Small and mixed packs choose each animal's own actions; some animals fall back when hurt.

changes.title: Guest room crossing
items: Walking between treehouse rooms no longer discards a friend's pending movement.
